generic_sampling_rules.int_primary_key: Sequential integers starting at 1, unique per table, never NULL; generated rows continue after the compact DB's max PK.
generic_sampling_rules.int_foreign_key: Sample from the parent table's final primary-key pool (compact + generated); include NULL rows (nullable FK) and at least one parent row with no child.
generic_sampling_rules.real_generic: Uniform real rounded to 2 decimals in [0, 1000000].
generic_sampling_rules.text_generic: Random short token string; include near-variant duplicates (case/whitespace variants) at ~10% share.
generic_sampling_rules.text_name: Random plausible full name; unique per table.
generic_sampling_rules.date_text_iso: Random date in YYYY-MM-DD format between 1970-01-01 and 2000-12-31.
generic_sampling_rules.boundary_numeric: For each listed literal L, guarantee at least one generated row at L-1, L, L+1 (respecting column step); do not rely on probabilistic sampling.
generic_sampling_rules.tie_order: Plant at least two rows at the value occupying the listed LIMIT rank; the tie value must sit at that rank given the total row count (compact + generated).
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: For nullable columns, plant NULLs at the compact DB's per-column share (0% observed) but at least one NULL row per nullable column per instance; NULLs are never replaced to satisfy a rule.
generic_sampling_rules.duplicate_share: For DISTINCT-target columns, plant duplicates so that distinct/total ratio yields a 20-50% duplicate share across compact + generated rows.
generic_sampling_rules.group_sizes: For GROUP-target columns, plant groups of size 1, 2 and >= 3 across compact + generated rows.
